edit.description: gate-revert arm of `modeLines` renders the gate's own attribution per the cite
gate-revert fixture and block assertions for the widened arm

summary: The gate-revert <prior-attempt> block renders the gate's verdict and failingFiles, and states a blamesSpan:false revert as a disowned blame

per.section: Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick

acceptance: A gate-revert block shows `verdict` and `failingFiles` where the record carries them; a `blamesSpan: false` record's block says the revert happened and the gate disowned the blame, in place of the change-your-approach instruction.
tests: the gate-revert block renders the gate's verdict and failing files where the record carries them
a gate-revert block whose record disowns the blame says so instead of instructing the agent to change approach
notes: The record's three fields are already stamped by `buildGateRevert` (src/priorAttempts.ts); only the renderer is short of the cite. The per-mode case in tests/Prompt.test.ts reads every non-envelope field's value lines off its fixture, so a fixture carrying `blamesSpan: false` demands the literal `false` somewhere in the block while the cite asks for prose — how that case reads a boolean field is build's call.
